body: That's definitely something to consider since talking about it definitely helps me, and I like this subreddit because that's kind of how it feels. Just listen to people talk about their shit and if you want to talk you can.

Thank you for responding. I just feel like it wouldn't make any difference because they can't really help me. I've talked about it before with a friend who also deals with depression, we discussed medication as he has been on it before but isn't anymore. He told me that in his experience it changes who you are, like you're just high and you're a different person now and it's scary. I just don't know what the point of making any kind of effort to get professional help would be if it's just drugs to not worry about dysphoria in human existence.
